{"metadata":{"description":"针对DSH web前端设计，对模型选择面板进行了升级，改为供应商-模型两侧滚动面板，并添加了搜索框","id":"gh:1334867421","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-model-picker","slug":"Sanqi-normal/dsh-model-picker","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"针对DSH web前端设计，对模型选择面板进行了升级，改为供应商-模型两侧滚动面板，并添加了搜索框"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-model-picker[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"为 dsh web GUI 的模型选择器提供增强面板：**左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表**，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索——替代默认的单列长滚动分组列表。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An enhanced model picker for the dsh web GUI: a **left provider column with the model list on the ri"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ght**, both independently scrollable, plus a cross-provider search box — replacing the default singl"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e-column grouped list."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能 Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 左栏按提供商纵向排列（独立滚动，带模型计数徽章），右栏显示当前提供商的模型（独立滚动）——几十个提供商、上百个模型也能顺畅浏览
- 默认选中当前模型所属的提供商；点击任意提供商即切换
- 顶部搜索"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"框跨提供商匹配（提供商名 / 模型名 / 描述，大小写不敏感），结果带提供商名，点选即切换
- 保留推理档位切换（当前模型支持时显示在底部）、加载 / 错误 / 重试 / 空态
- 与内置 `/mod"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"el` 弹层共享同一份模型目录（`ctx.modelDirectories`），任何一处切换另一处立即同步；composer 的模型阻塞逻辑不受影响
- 界面跟随系统深浅色主题；文案中英文自动切换"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A left column lists providers (independently scrollable, with model-count badges); the right column "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"shows the active provider's models (independently scrollable). The search box matches across provide"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"rs (provider name / model name / description, case-insensitive). Reasoning-effort switching, loading"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"/error/retry/empty states are preserved, and the panel shares the same per-session model directory a"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"s the built-in `/model` popup. Dark/light theme aware; UI text follows the system language."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 安装 Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"方式一：从 **npm registry** 安装（推荐，无 git 克隆 / prepare 脚本步骤）："},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"方式二：从 GitHub 源码安装："},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"安装后**重启 web 服务**生效："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"GitHub 源安装会执行包内 prepare 脚本，如被 pnpm 拦截，把提示的包名加入 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 后重试。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 使用 Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"重启后打开任意会话，点击 composer 工具行右端的模型选择器（发送按钮左侧）："},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- 左栏点击提供商切换右侧模型列表；右栏点击模型即选中（✓ 标记当前模型）
- 顶部输入关键词，右栏切换为跨提供商搜索结果；点击左侧任意提供商即退出搜索并切换
- 当前模型支持推理档位时，菜单底部出现"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"型列表；右栏点击模型即选中（✓ 标记当前模型）
- 顶部输入关键词，右栏切换为跨提供商搜索结果；点击左侧任意提供商即退出搜索并切换
- 当前模型支持推理档位时，菜单底部出现档位按钮（含「提供方默认」）"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"After the web server restarts, open any session and click the model selector at the right end of the"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"r restarts, open any session and click the model selector at the right end of the composer tool row:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Click a provider in the left column to switch the right list; click a model to select it (✓ marks "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"the current one)
- Type in the search box to see cross-provider results; clicking any provider exits"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" search
- When the current model supports reasoning efforts, effort buttons (including "provider def"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ault") appear at the bottom of the menu"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 工作原理 How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"持久化 bundle（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`），由 `dsh plugin add` 的 reconcile "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"自动加入 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 层："},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Client 半**（`lib/client.js`）：通过 `exports["./client"]` + `dsh.client` 声明被 web 前端加载，注册到 composer 的 "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"`conversation.input.model` 座位（priority -1，顶替默认实现）；数据复用内置 `ui-model-selection` 的 `ctx.modelDirectorie"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s` 每会话目录（`session.models` / `session.selectModel`），不引入第二份状态
- **Host 半**（`lib/host.js`）：空实现——Node 侧 "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"loader 以包根入口导入它（浏览器专属的 `lib/client.js` 必须只在 `./client` 导出下被 web 端加载），无网络请求、无持久化状态"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 要求与限制 Requirements and limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- 需要 web profile 已装载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`（web-app 内置，通常已存在）；缺失时选择器座位保持空置（回退安"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"全）
- 动态安装后需重启 web 服务生效（与所有 profile bundle 一致）
- 仅影响 composer 的模型选择座位；`/model` 弹层保持原样，但与面板共享同一份当前选择"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
